operative_context: Early operator cancellation may involve a tolerance window or grace period during which penalties should not apply
Cancellation rules currently allow stopping an active rent
exceptions: Penalty fees should not be applied during an operator's initial grace-period window for early cancellation
conflicts_or_obsolete: Earlier lifecycle guidance included an exemption for penalties during operator tolerance window, but this exemption language may have been removed or is missing from the latest documentation
Current cancellation rules do not explicitly document the grace-period exemption that was referenced in earlier guidance
notes: R30 targets operator grace-period cancellation behavior. PRIMARY evidence (E1-E9) establishes that operators can trigger cancellations and that a tolerance window existed in earlier lifecycle guidance to waive penalties, but this exemption is now missing or unclear in current rules. E2 explicitly documents the discrepancy: a penalty was applied during early operator cancellation despite earlier guidance suggesting a tolerance window should have prevented it. CONTEXT evidence (E10-E11) confirms ambiguity around grace-period cancellation rules. The requirement lacks specification of grace-period duration, conditions, and whether the exemption was intentionally dropped. E7 (Cancellation penalty bug) and E8-E9 (availability/maintenance implementations) provide implementation context but do not resolve the specification gap.
